definitions.explanation: A clinic that provides manual body adjustment and manipulation therapy to address musculoskeletal issues. Distinct from Western chiropractic, Japanese seitai encompasses various traditional and modern bodywork techniques.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{整体院|せいたいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My lower back hurts, so I'm going to a bodywork clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{整体院|せいたいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new chiropractic clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧{整体院|せいたいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{肩|かた}こり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった。
examples.english: Since I started going to the bodywork clinic my friend recommended, my stiff shoulders have improved.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧ (body adjustment/alignment) and {院|いん} (clinic/institution). {整体院|せいたいいん} are extremely common in Japan — they can be found near most train stations and in shopping areas. They are not medical facilities and do not require a medical license, unlike ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧ (bonesetting clinics) which are licensed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整体院|せいたいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to regularly visit a bodywork clinic
- {整体院|せいたいいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to open a bodywork clinic
- {整体院|せいたいいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{施術|せじゅつ}→施術：20663_sejutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive treatment at a bodywork clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧: bonesetting clinic — licensed facility for treating bone and joint issues
- {鍼灸院|しんきゅういん}: acupuncture and moxibustion clinic — uses needles and heat therapy
- ⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: massage shop — focuses on muscle relaxation rather than structural alignment
